messages:
yusuf: Quick heads-up
we're getting a cluster of SAST failures and some DAST artifact unwrap denies after the private keystore rollout. CI shows KMS Decrypt:AccessDenied for the new infra role. Blocking a few hotfix PRs.
sec-bot: automated alert: `scan-fleet` failures=39 fail_rate=0.18 increased=+12% recent_errors=["KMS:AccessDenied"] run: https://ci.internal/runs/24567
tamara: Which principal exactly is being denied? We switched from per-service SA to `priv-keystore-role` in the last change.
yusuf: Log excerpt: ```2024-11-21T02:11:03Z scan ERROR decrypt artifact=gh-77099 error=AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:sts::888888888:assumed-role/priv-keystore-role/scanner is not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:888888888:key/abcd-ef01```
greg: That key's policy still lists the old SA principal (`serviceAccount:scanner@redwood`). Two options: add the assumed-role ARN to the key policy, or temporarily re-add the inline SA grant. Prefer the key policy patch.
infra-oncall: I can open a soft-fail waiver for the scan jobset for 60m. Would rather we avoid disabling scans entirely.
nina: Short-term triage plan: 1) soft-fail waiver (infra-oncall) 2) stage key-policy patch + decrypt smoke (tamara) 3) re-run failing subset 4) add CloudTrail filter for KMS Decrypt AccessDenied and an annotation hook for CI (greg) 5) add RBAC->KMS mapping to the private-keystore runbook (yusuf).
tamara: I'll apply a staging patch adding `arn:aws:iam::888888888:role/priv-keystore-role` and `arn:aws:sts::888888888:assumed-role/priv-keystore-role/*` to the key policy and run a smoke decrypt.
sec-bot: incident-note created: "private-keystore-scan-decrypt-deny" id=INC-20241121-05 link: https://inc.internal/INC-20241121-05
greg: Also seeing a pattern: recent SAST rule `long-hex-constant` flagged a lot of generated test fixtures. Suggest we add a repo-level suppression for `testdata/**` and `gen/**` and lower severity. I'll open a tiny PR.
yusuf: Important: add an entry to the RBAC change PR template: when you change a scanner's principal, list KMS keys that reference the removed principal and update key policies or document the migration. We should keep this in the private-keystore onboarding doc too.
infra-oncall: Waiver created WAIV-20241121-09 for 60m.
tamara: Staging policy updated, smoke decrypt passed: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://c.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:888888888:key/abcd-ef01 --profile staging-scan` -> OK. Re-ran subset of jobs and unwraps succeeded.
greg: PR opened for SAST suppression: https://git.internal/sast-config/pull/215 (whitelist gen/**, testdata/**, severity adjust).
yusuf: After staging validation, we'll roll the key-policy to prod and close the waiver. I'll update the private-keystore runbook with sample commands and a rollback stanza (re-add inline SA grant or revert role change).
sec-bot: alert updated: KMS-decrypt spikes returning to baseline. WAIV-20241121-09 expires in 35m.
infra-oncall: Rolling key-policy patch to prod in 10m after final verification.
tamara: Prod patch live, decrypt smoke against archived artifact succeeded. Re-ran blocked PRs; CI unblocked.
yusuf: Action items: - infra PR template update to include KMS reference scan (greg) - runbook chapter for private-keystore RBAC->KMS mapping (yusuf) - CloudTrail filter + CI annotator for Decrypt denies (greg) - SAST suppression PR merge (greg) - short postmortem note in incidents (tamara).
sec-bot: incident closed: id=INC-20241121-05 summary="RBAC change caused key-policy mismatch -> KMS Decrypt denies -> SAST/DAST pipeline noise; mitigated by key-policy update + CI waiver + heuristic tuning"
